name: Alumil Aluminium Industry S.A.
summary: Alumil Aluminium Industry S.A., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells aluminum products in Greece, Balkans, and internationally. It offers sliding, hinged, and folding windows and doors; hinged and pivoted entrance doors; fire rated system; shutters; flyscreen system; facades; and partitions, as well as outdoor solutions, including pergolas, fences, railings, decking, and canopies.
